_doc: Allow-list for scripts/ui-lint.mjs. Keep it minimal and give a reason for every entry. 'tokenBlocks' = CSS selectors whose whole block may define colours (the design tokens). 'files' = whole files that may contain colour literals (glob, relative to frontend/). 'lines' = a regex allowed on lines of a given file (and optionally one rule).

files.reason: logo assets are images; no colour literals expected, listed so a future inline SVG logo is allowed
